title: A Restaurant Review
text:
Last week, Ana visited a small Italian restaurant downtown. She wrote a review on the internet. She said the pasta was delicious. The service was slow, though.

The owner read Ana's review and smiled. He thanked her for her honest opinion. He said the staff would try to be faster. Ana plans to return next month with her friends.

questions.text: Where did Ana go last week?
options: to a small Italian restaurant downtown

questions.text: What did the staff say they would try to do?
How does Ana feel about the restaurant?

questions.text: Why did the owner smile when he read the review?
options: He was happy to hear an honest opinion
He was angry about the review
He wanted to sell the restaurant
He did not read the review

vocabulary.definition: a written opinion about a place, product or service
the way customers are helped by staff

paragraph_translations: La semana pasada, Ana visitó un pequeño restaurante italiano en el centro. Escribió una reseña en internet. Dijo que la pasta estaba deliciosa. Sin embargo, el servicio fue lento.
El dueño leyó la reseña de Ana y sonrió. Le agradeció su opinión sincera. Dijo que el personal intentaría ser más rápido. Ana planea volver el próximo mes con sus amigos.
